title: Managed Backup: ordinary retention
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines ordinary retention.

## Tier basis

**Default ordinary-copy retention period.** Default retention of ordinary backup copies; calendar days integer.

| Contract tier | Default ordinary-copy retention period |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | 35 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | 35 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | 35 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | 35 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | 35 |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | 35 |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, default ordinary-copy retention period is 35.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, default ordinary-copy retention period stays the same.
